notes.title: Game Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello Proxies !

Patch 1.0.2 is live.

New features


 Added highest grade unlocked per level on the leaderboards (If you had a grade previously it won't show until you play the level again)


Fixes and improvements:


 Fixed a bug where you can shoot through a wall in the Cultists Hideout
 Fixed typo in song name Detox
 Little changes to Nightclub rooftops persecution layout to add a little more cover where you can be shot off screen easily
 Remove collisions in Nightclub rooftops persecution that let you get stuck on top of a billboard
 Fixed a bug that won't allow players in certain situations to unlock the Big Boss Achievement
 Fixed a but regarding the Vulkan Boss fight and how the bridge button behaves.
 Improved lateral doors behavior.
 Fixed Plasma song that sometimes doesn't restart.
 Fixed a bug where some melee enemies didn't register proper hits


Also we are preparing a poll to see what you want to see in the future patches of Esse Proxy

Thanks everyone for your support!

Cheers

notes.title: Game patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Here are some bugs we've fixing yesterday:


 Removed tutorial from the level selection
 Fixed level in level selection not being unlocked correctly
 Fixed error with mouse cursor being displayed on the center of the screen when you play with the gamepad.
 Fixed error where sometimes an incorrect character was being selected on the level select screen.

Thank for all your support. 

And remember to keep on reporting bugs on our discord so we can improve the game the best we can!


Cheers!

notes.title: ⭐️Gameplay Demo⭐️
notes.content:
Everyday we are close to the release date we aimed from a year ago and the game has changed a lot. We feel confident that everyone of you will love the new version of the game.

A brief summarised changelog next:


 Story Mode. Sneak peak to some bits and pieces of the game's story
 New weapons and an improved UI
 New skills. Idris has a brand new skill.
 Improvements in the melee system. Characters now have attacks that match their playstyle and personality
 Full Controller Support. This time for real! Previous version had partial controller support, now you can use the UI and play the full game from the controller, even on Steam's Big Picture!
 Tons of visual improvements


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39673349/1ee194d87e6cd020703618a83ed7011b3ebad1f6.png

notes.content:

October Update

Esse Proxy has been selected as an Epic MegaGrants recipient 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39673349/d1590106d8468778b90ccd8edd735c04ce2bfa28.jpg

Epic MegaGrants is a $100 million program that supports game developers, enterprise professionals, media and entertainment creators, students, educators, and tool developers doing amazing things with Unreal Engine or enhancing open-source capabilities for the 3D graphics community.
After a presentation a few games are selected as recipients for this support program and Esse Proxy is one of them!

Thanks to your votes we won the Fan Favourite Week at GDWC 2021 and we go for more! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39673349/9af80f52a4dd72bb7f31fde4608d58a90c622256.png


We are participating on the Game Development World Charmpionship and thanks to all of your votes we won the weekly round. Now we go for more, with the chance to win the Fan Favourite of all 2021.

Happy Halloween and Spooktober for everyone!
